questions.question: What happens if you unlock the pintle hook before removing the dolly from under the rear trailer?

options.text: The tow bar may fly up and cause injury.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tow bar may fly up and cause injury.
questions.explanation: Always remove the dolly from under the rear trailer before unlocking the pintle hook. If you don't, the dolly tow bar can fly up and cause serious injury.

questions.question: How can you avoid slowing down traffic when driving a large truck?

options.text: Pass other vehicles while driving uphill.
Stay in the right lane whenever possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane whenever possible.
questions.explanation: If your heavy load prevents you from driving as fast as other traffic, stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What should you do when driving through fog?
questions.explanation: When driving in fog, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: What is important to do while driving?

options.text: Plan how to handle dangerous situations before they happen.
Turn your head all the way around instead of using mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan how to handle dangerous situations before they happen.
questions.explanation: Watch the road for hazards. Think ahead about what you would do if a hazard becomes an emergency.

questions.question: What is one reason hydraulic brakes can fail?

options.text: The brakes are used too much in one day.

questions.explanation: Hydraulic brake failures happen for two main reasons. The first is brake fade from overuse on downhill grades. The second is loss of hydraulic pressure in the braking system. Well-maintained brakes rarely fail, but you should know what to do if they do.

questions.question: Is it important to keep space between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: Yes, it gives you time to react to hazards.
Only if you have a passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it gives you time to react to hazards.
questions.explanation: Keep space cushions on all sides of your vehicle for safe driving. This gives you time to act if a problem occurs.

questions.question: When do rollovers happen?

options.text: When drivers don't drive fast enough.
When drivers pay attention to the road.

questions.explanation: Rollovers happen when drivers take turns too fast. Always turn and navigate curves slowly and safely.

questions.question: When driving downhill, you should brake until you reach what speed?
questions.explanation: Going downhill, hold the brake pedal until your vehicle slows to 5 mph below your safe speed. Then release the brake. Repeat this process.

questions.question: What should you check extra carefully in winter pre-trip inspections?
questions.explanation: During winter pre-trip inspections, pay extra attention to coolant and antifreeze levels, defrosting and heating equipment, wiper blades and windshield washers, tires and chains, lights and reflectors, windows and mirrors, handholds and steps, radiator shutters and winterfront, and the exhaust system.

questions.question: What do Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS) do?

options.text: Work with your normal brakes and do not reduce braking power.
Are not effective on larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work with your normal brakes and do not reduce braking power.
questions.explanation: ABS works alongside your normal braking system and does not increase or decrease braking power. ABS activates during hard braking to prevent wheels from locking up.

questions.question: What happens if a trailer is not at the proper height when coupling?

options.text: It will not make a difference.

questions.explanation: Before coupling a tractor and trailer, the trailer must be at the correct height. If the trailer is too low, the nose may be damaged. If it is too high, it may not couple properly.

questions.question: What is a converter gear?

options.text: A lock on a trailer door.
A trailer at the end of a combination.
Not necessary on doubles or triples.

questions.explanation: A converter gear on a dolly is a coupling device. It has one or two axles and a fifth wheel. A semi-trailer can be coupled to it at the rear of a tractor-trailer combination.

questions.question: Why is driving too fast dangerous?

options.text: It is a major cause of fatal crashes.
It is a good way to get to your destination quickly.
It should only be done if the roadway is dry.
It is acceptable in light traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a major cause of fatal crashes.
questions.explanation: Driving at excessive speeds causes many fatal crashes. Never drive faster than the posted speed limit. Always adjust your speed based on road and weather conditions.

questions.question: What is an advantage of convex mirrors?

options.text: They cannot be used on vehicles transporting hazardous materials.
They are illegal in most states.
They help drivers see a larger area.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help drivers see a larger area.
questions.explanation: Many large vehicles use curved convex mirrors. These mirrors let drivers see a wider area than flat mirrors. However, objects appear smaller and farther away than they actually are.

questions.question: What does an air compressor governor control?

options.text: When the air compressor pumps air into the storage tanks.
How fast air is pumped into the storage tanks.
The temperature of the air pumped into the storage tanks.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the air compressor pumps air into the storage tanks.
questions.explanation: In an air brake system, the air compressor governor controls when air is pumped into the air storage tanks.

questions.question: What two indicators tell you when to shift to a higher gear?

options.text: Oil pressure and air brake pressure.

questions.explanation: Two things tell you when to upshift. First is engine speed (rpm). Read your vehicle's manual to learn the right rpm range, then shift up when you reach the top. Second is road speed (mph). Learn what speeds each gear handles, then watch the speedometer and shift as needed.

questions.question: What should you use the trailer hand valve for?
questions.explanation: Using the trailer hand valve while driving can cause a skid. Use it only when testing the trailer brakes.

questions.question: When should oil pressure reach a normal level after starting the engine?
questions.explanation: After starting the engine, watch your gauges. Oil pressure should reach a normal level within a few seconds.

questions.question: If your brakes fail on a downgrade, what is your best option to stop?
questions.explanation: If your brakes fail on a downgrade, look for a way to stop your vehicle safely. An escape ramp is the safest option.

questions.question: Why should you not use the trailer hand valve while driving?

options.text: It will disconnect from the vehicle.

questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve while driving. It can cause your trailer to skid.
